findings.problem: In Spain the usual word for putting together furniture or a puzzle is montar, not armar, so spain should not be null.

back.es: armar: to assemble, to put together (also to arm; to set up or cause, as in armar un lío)
back.example: My dad put the table together in ten minutes.

note: The hint is needed: it separates this card from the word's "to arm" card and rules out juntar (to put together in the sense of joining).
